python3 << 'EOF'
# CPI-U annual average values (BLS official)
cpi_1992 = 140.3
cpi_1993 = 144.5
cpi_1994 = 148.2

# Interest-bearing debt for Series E and EE (calendar years, in millions)
debt_1992 = 144724
debt_1993 = 158633
debt_1994 = 166731

# Adjust to constant 1994 dollars
adjusted_1992 = debt_1992 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1992)
adjusted_1993 = debt_1993 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1993)
adjusted_1994 = debt_1994 * (cpi_1994 / cpi_1994)  # stays the same

print(f"Adjusted 1992: {adjusted_1992:.2f}")
print(f"Adjusted 1993: {adjusted_1993:.2f}")
print(f"Adjusted 1994: {adjusted_1994:.2f}")

# Calculate mean
values = [adjusted_1992, adjusted_1993, adjusted_1994]
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.2f}")

# Calculate sample standard deviation (n-1)
import math
squared_diffs = [(x - mean)**2 for x in values]
variance = sum(squared_diffs) / (n - 1)
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Sample Std Dev (n-1): {std_dev:.2f}")

# Calculate z-score for 1994
z_score = (adjusted_1994 - mean) / std_dev
print(f"\nZ-score for 1994: {z_score:.2f}")
EOF
